name: knife-slash
note: CU-107: the issue knife. A short cock, a thrust at arm's length, a small cut across, then back to the pose. t is 0..1 of the knife swing (0.22 s). Offsets in his own axes (x out to the knife side, y up, z forward), metres. The arm reaches the point by IK; the blade's turn in the fist is updateKnifeAnim.

places.rest: where the pose has the hand this frame (the swing starts and ends there)
places.chest: a point in front of his upper chest (torso space 0, 1.22 m, 0.12 m)
